site_analysis_review.platform_notes: Custom SPA with React-like components. Site uses Tailwind utility classes and server-rendered JSON-LD. Confirmed as custom build — no CMS markers.
site_analysis_review.anti_bot_notes: No anti-bot protection detected. Direct HTTP access works. reCAPTCHA only on contact form, not job pages.
site_analysis_review.mechanism_notes: Site analyzer correctly identified JS rendering requirement. Job detail pages have server-rendered JSON-LD but the full DOM content (overview list, badges, benefits, etc.) requires JS execution. Playwright is the correct approach.
corrections: Product URL pattern correction: Job detail pages use /job-details/{id}/{slug}/ not /jobs/c/{category}/. The /jobs/c/ pattern is for category listing pages.

Job ID note: The URL contains the primary job ID (3533783) matching JSON-LD identifier. The page also displays 'Job ID 1287788' which appears to be an internal AMN reference — use URL/JSON-LD ID as the canonical identifier.

connectivity.notes: Job detail pages render fully in Playwright without proxy. JSON-LD structured data is present. No anti-bot protection.

mechanism_reassessment.reason: Site analyzer correctly recommended playwright. Job detail pages use a React-like SPA architecture with Tailwind CSS. While JSON-LD structured data is server-rendered and available in the initial HTML, the full DOM content (overview list items with facility type, shift, start date, duration, benefits, attractions) requires JavaScript execution. The primary extraction strategy should use JSON-LD for structured fields (title, salary, location, dates) and CSS selectors within the .community-job-details container for additional fields (facility info, shift details, benefits). No anti-bot protection detected — standard Playwright without stealth or proxy is sufficient.
mechanism_reassessment.extraction_strategy:
1. Navigate to job URL with Playwright
2. Extract JSON-LD from script[type='application/ld+json']
3. Parse JobPosting schema for structured fields (title, salary, location, dates, org)
4. Extract overview fields from ul.pl-2 list items using label-value pattern
5. Extract benefits and attractions from remaining ul elements
6. Extract badges, specialty, and posted date from their respective selectors
7. All extraction targets the .community-job-details container

overview_list_extraction_helper.notes: The JOB OVERVIEW section contains a ul.pl-2 list where each li has a consistent structure: li > div.flex > span.icon + div > p.subtitle-two (label) + p.body-small or a (value). Use this JS to extract all key-value pairs:
overview_list_extraction_helper.js_code: () => { const list = document.querySelector('ul.pl-2'); if (!list) return {}; const items = {}; for (const li of list.children) { const div = li.querySelector(':scope > div'); if (!div) continue; const valueDiv = div.children[1]; if (!valueDiv) continue; const ps = valueDiv.querySelectorAll('p.subtitle-two, p.body-small'); if (ps.length >= 2) { items[ps[0].textContent.trim()] = ps[1].textContent.trim(); } else if (ps.length === 1) { const a = valueDiv.querySelector('a'); items[ps[0].textContent.trim()] = a?.textContent.trim() || ps[0].textContent.trim(); } } return items; }
